errata.error: CCO's list puts West Bay Harbour at 50.7102° N, 2.8200° W, 3.9 km west of the harbour. GESLA's record of the gauge, which CCO supplied, and CMEMS's copy of it both put it at 50.7089° N, 2.7641° W.
errata.response: The station refresh moves it to 50.70888, −2.76411, listed in `POSITIONS` in `src/positions.ts`. If CCO moves the station, the refresh reports the entry and fails the run until a person checks it.
errata.report: Sent to the Channel Coastal Observatory's API team on 2026-11-17 as a heads-up, with a full errata report to follow once the history is imported. No answer yet.

errata.error: CCO's levels hold fill values where a gauge sent nothing: 999.9999 or −999.9999, with no flag. A year of Exmouth's has 16 readings of 999.9999 from 18:30 on 18 December 2019, Hastings Pier's 2019 has 2 on 19 June, and Swanage Pier's 2018 has 2 of −999.9999 on 23 April. GESLA's records of CCO's gauges hold such values too, as erratum `gesla-fill-values` says. A value of 999.9999 lies inside the store's span of −500 to 9,000 m.
errata.response: A level of 999 m or more in either direction is left out as missing, as is 9999.
errata.evidence: One year of readings at six sites, 2013 to 2020, read from the API on 2026-11-16: Deal Pier 2015, Arun Platform 2012, Brighton 2020, Swanage Pier 2018, Exmouth 2019 and Hastings Pier 2019. The other years of these sites, and the other nine sites, weren't scanned.
errata.report: Sent to the Channel Coastal Observatory's API team on 2026-11-17 as a heads-up, with a full errata report to follow once the history is imported. No answer yet.

errata.error: A request for a window with no readings answers `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":]}`, which isn't JSON. Lymington and Brighton instead answer HTTP 500 for a window before their first reading.
errata.response: The adapter reads the first as no values. The second is an error, so a backfill of those two sites starts at their first year (README, Running ingest).
errata.evidence: Requests of 2026-11-16: Herne Bay for 1 June 2001 answers the first body; Lymington for 1 June 2008 and Brighton for 1 June 2005 answer 500 with `Internal Server Error`.
errata.report: Sent to the Channel Coastal Observatory's API team on 2026-11-17 as a heads-up, with a full errata report to follow once the history is imported. No answer yet.
